name: sfizz
character: sfizz 1.2.3: the SFZ engine that renders a MIDI file through an .sfz file to a WAV, offline (BSD-2-Clause; the project is archived, so the version is pinned)

darwin.note: macOS archive holds plugins, not sfizz_render. Build it (cmake -DSFIZZ_RENDER=ON) or set SFIZZ_RENDER=/path/to/sfizz_render

linux.note: No prebuilt sfizz_render. Install sfizz from your package manager or build it, then set SFIZZ_RENDER=/path/to/sfizz_render

notes: Windows: bin/Release/sfizz_render.exe next to sfizz.dll. Measured on this laptop: renders are byte-identical across runs, including random round-robin.
